entities.name: Saviour Church on Sennaya Square
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Assumption Church, commonly known as the Saviour Church, located on Sennaya Square in St. Petersburg, Russia, was a Late Baroque penticupolar church sponsored by Orthodox merchants trading at the nearby Sennaya Square market.
